name: Folklore Reclaimed
source:
The line of transmission of his culture had been severed. The new generation doesn't know their stories aside from the "official" version that had been purged of anything deemed controversial. That's why Homeka decided to write his thesis on this lost folklore. Today, he'll be speaking to an elder who escaped persecution who affirms remembering the stories of old.

Discuss with Chayon and compare their recollections to the notes you have amassed. You will be deciding the future shape of your people's folklore!

[From [url=https://fdrstar.itch.io/folklore-reclaimed]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他的文化传承线路被切断了。除了“官方”版本之外，新一代不知道他们的故事，而“官方”版本已清除了任何被视为有争议的内容。这就是霍姆卡决定以这个失落的民间传说为主题撰写论文的原因。今天，他将与一位逃脱迫害的长者交谈，这位长者肯定会记住古老的故事。

与Chayon讨论并将他们的回忆与你积累的笔记进行比较。你们将决定你们人民民俗的未来形态！

[来自[url=https://fdrstar.itch.io/folklore-reclaimed]Itch.io[/url]]
